subject: Close-plan: data certification for upcoming revenue commits
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Katie Larson <katie@cloudmetric.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close-plan: data certification for upcoming revenue commits

Team —

We need a quick certification pass on the opportunities CloudMetric expects to close this week so Finance can lock commits for the May forecast. Attached is the export pulled from HubSpot (oppty_data_export_20270503.csv). Please confirm the following fields by EOD Thu 5/6 for each listed opp:

- Confirmed amount (USD) — final negotiated amount to be invoiced
- Product/SKU mapping (exact SKU string)
- Next step & owner (e.g., "PO received / Katie")
- Probability (set to the number we should use for forecast commit)

I've highlighted three opportunities in the sheet (Deal IDs: 2384, 2410, 2449) that require quick decisions. Ben — can you lead the internal certs? Marissa — flag anything that needs legal/SOW follow-up. Katie — if CloudMetric is comfortable with the amounts/SOWs, please confirm invoice contact and expected signature timeline.

Attachments: oppty_data_export_20270503.csv (CSV export; contains Deal ID, Amount, SKU, Close Date, Owner, Notes)

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Larson <katie@cloudmetric.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close-plan: data certification for upcoming revenue commits

Hannah —

Thanks for the export. Quick update from my side after scanning the sheet:

- Deal 2384 (CloudMetric): Amount in HS export was $320,000. Sales negotiated to $305,000 (discount for multi-region). SKU should be "RWD-ENT-16GPU" (sales ops confirmed). I will update HubSpot amount and SKU and set next step to "SOW sent — AE follow-up". Proposed probability: 85%.
- Deal 2410 (CloudMetric - pilot): Confirmed amount $45,000. SKU "RWD-PILOT-1MO". Next step: "PO pending, finance contact provided". Proposed probability: 60% (pending PO).

Open items: Deal 2449 has conflicting product lines — sales champion listed both Evaluation and Production SKUs. I flagged it in the sheet and dropped a comment for Marissa to check whether Legal needs to split the SOW.

I'll make the HubSpot edits and add an internal comment with rationale. Marissa — can you validate the split for 2449 and confirm if we should move any ARR to a separate line item?

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Katie Larson <katie@cloudmetric.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close-plan: data certification for upcoming revenue commits

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks for the note. We can confirm the negotiated numbers for 2384 and 2410 — 2384 at $305,000 and 2410 at $45,000 look correct to us. For 2449, the customer team is still deciding whether to bundle evaluation into the production SOW; we should expect final confirmation by Wednesday EOD.

Invoice / billing contact: invoices@cloudmetric.com. We can sign SOW v2 this week; sending the current SOW as an attachment for your reference (SOW_v2.pdf). Expected signature timeline: signatures by 5/7, invoice to be processed within 5 business days after signature.

Katie
Katie Larson
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudMetric
katie@cloudmetric.com
Attachment: SOW_v2.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Katie Larson <katie@cloudmetric.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close-plan: data certification for upcoming revenue commits

Appreciate the quick confirms. Two operational asks before I pass to Finance for commit:

1) Ben — please *actually* update HubSpot fields (Amount, SKU, Probability, Next Step) and leave a short comment that Finance can reference.
2) Marissa — tag Legal only if splitting 2449 will change billing terms (we need clear invoicing line items).
3) Katie — once SOW is signed, please drop us the signed copy or a DocuSign link; Finance prefers an explicit signature artifact before marking as committed.

I'll hold the final forecast commit until I see HubSpot updates + signed SOW for 2384. If we miss the Thursday close window, we'll still include a soft-commit in the supplemental forecast but mark checkbox as "at-risk".

Hannah

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Larson <katie@cloudmetric.com>

All done — I updated HubSpot for the two confirmed deals and left detailed comments (see HubSpot link below).

Summary:
- Deal 2384: Amount set to $305,000; SKU = RWD-ENT-16GPU; Next step = "SOW sent — AE follow-up"; Probability = 85% (certified by AE).
- Deal 2410: Amount $45,000; SKU = RWD-PILOT-1MO; Next step = "PO pending — waiting on finance"; Probability = 60% (pending PO).
- Deal 2449: Left at 40% until CloudMetric confirms bundling. I added a note for Legal to evaluate splitting line items if needed.

Katie — can you please post the DocuSign link (or attach signed SOW) when available? Finance will accept a DocuSign embedded link or a signed PDF.
